visualRisks.description: The route path crosses through areas that are not roads, which could be visually confusing.
The color of the dock (#87cefa) is very similar to the water (#00bfff), which might cause visual confusion.

navigationRisks.description: There are several points in the route where it seems to end abruptly without a clear next step, potentially leading to user frustration or disorientation.
The route appears to loop back on itself between points 102 and 106, which could be confusing for users trying to follow the path.
